message:
4 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:33: interpolation reads `m` → "Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:35: interpolation reads `f` → "Delete "
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:37: interpolation reads `x` → "Remove the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:39: interpolation reads `row` → "Close the row"
description: Sentences a call draws through a name the template binds (measured: each drawn): a method of the string a `@let` holds, a function a `@let` holds, called, a loop's item handed to a method of the class (`upper`, which returns it in capitals), and a template handed to a method of the class whose result an outlet draws with a context (`pick`, which returns it). A call gives what it is called on and what it is handed, a name and a template among them, so the refusal counts four; a read that took a method of the class for code that draws nothing passed the last two, and main refused them.
